text:
ana: seeing increased GPU preempt churn in eu-west3 for the past 90m. Small pods getting evicted to coalesce for reserved workloads.
rohit: logs: repeated fit_failures + preempt loops. Likely hetero GPU sizes + strict binpack.
claire: impact?\rana: some nightly pipelines delayed ~3-5m, customers pinged.
rohit: quick mitigation: 1) bump warm-pool in eu-west3 by +25%, 2) lower packStrictness from 0.96->0.88 in canary, 3) add toleration to spot namespaces.
claire: commands I'll run now:
```bash
kubectl -n infra-scale scale deploy/warm-pool-euw --replicas=50 # from 40
kubectl -n kube-system patch configmap gpu-scheduler-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"packStrictness":"0.88","cohort":"euw-canary"}}'
kubectl -n spot-batch patch deploy --all -p '{"spec":{"template":{"spec":{"tolerations":[{"key":"gpu_reserve","operator":"Exists","effect":"NoSchedule","tolerationSeconds":1800}]}}}}'
```
infra-bot: [runbook] id=r-3187 owner=claire cohort=eu-west3 duration=30m.
nana: warm-pool scaled to 50, canary config applied to 10% schedulers, tolerations patched.
infra-bot: [metric] preempt_rate delta=-14% (10m), fit_failures delta=-18% (10m).
rohit: early improvement. Keep window 30m and collect allocation traces. If stable, plan RFC for warm-pool-first scoring.
claire: noted. Revert changes if reserved-job tail latency increases beyond 20%.
